title: Android editor real-newline and line-number fix
changes: Fix Android virtual Enter so insertParagraph and insertLineBreak create actual Luau newlines with existing auto-indentation
Add a dedicated ↵ Enter button to the mobile code toolbar so each tap inserts a real numbered line
Update gutter line numbers immediately when edits change the number of lines, instead of waiting for syntax highlighting
Keep highlighted code and editable textarea using identical wrapping rules when restoring a saved project
Show ↪ Wrap on when visual line wrapping is enabled, explaining why a wrapped row does not get another line number
Preserve source text and saved scripts; do not silently turn visually wrapped rows into newlines
